lines.beaver: 민지 씨, 이번 보고서 정말 꼼꼼하게 썼더라고요.
lines.beaver_en: Minji, you wrote this report really meticulously.
lines.beaver_roman: Minji ssi, ibeon bogoseo jeongmal kkomkkomhage sseotdeoragoyo.
lines.en: Meticulous? Not at all. I just checked everything.

lines.beaver_en: That's what meticulous means. And you're so generous, too.
lines.learner: 너그럽기는요. 저도 가끔 못되게 말할 때가 있어요.
lines.en: Generous? Hardly. I say nasty things sometimes too.
lines.roman: Neogeureopgineunyo. Jeodo gakkeum mottoege malhal ttaega isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Come on, you? You always seem so gentle.
lines.learner: 순하기는요. 순해 보여도 고집이 좀 세요.
lines.en: Gentle? Not really. I may look mild, but I'm pretty stubborn.
lines.roman: Sunhagineunyo. Sunhae boyeodo gojibi jom seyo.

lines.beaver: 지난 회의 때 팀장님께 의견도 말했잖아요. 용감했어요.
lines.beaver_en: You shared your opinion with the team leader last meeting. That was brave.
lines.beaver_roman: Jinan hoeui ttae timjangnimkke uigyeondo malhaetjanayo. Yonggamhaesseoyo.
lines.learner: 용감하기는요. 너무 떨려서 어리석은 말만 했어요.
lines.en: Brave? No way. I was so nervous I only said foolish things.
lines.roman: Yonggamhagineunyo. Neomu tteollyeoseo eoriseogeun malman haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Not at all. Everyone said it was a good idea.
lines.en: That's a relief. I was worried I was just too eager.

lines.beaver_en: You're so humble. What's your secret to working so well?
lines.learner: 비결이라기보다 저 자신한테 좀 엄격한 편이에요.
lines.en: Not a secret, really. I'm just a bit strict with myself.
lines.roman: Bigyeoriragiboda jeo jasinhante jom eomgyeokan pyeonieyo.

lines.beaver_en: But you always look so relaxed. It's amazing.
lines.en: Relaxed? Not at all. Inside, I'm super busy.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, that's part of your individuality.
lines.en: Individuality? I'm just picky and fickle.

lines.beaver_en: You're really humble. And a good person, too.
lines.learner: 겸손은요. 인간성은 지훈 씨가 더 좋죠.
lines.en: Humble? Not me. You're the one with the better character, Jihun.
lines.roman: Gyeomsoneunyo. Inganseongeun Jihun ssiga deo jochyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 프로젝트도 같이 잘해 봐요. 커피 살게요!
lines.beaver_en: Let's do well on the next project together. Coffee's on me!
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum peurojekteudo gachi jalhae bwayo. Keopi salgeyo!
lines.learner: 좋아요. 칭찬해 줘서 고마워요. 커피는 제가 살게요.
lines.en: Sounds good. Thanks for the compliment. I'll buy the coffee.
lines.roman: Joayo. Chingchanhae jwoseo gomawoyo. Keopineun jega salgeyo.
